descriptionFull: The long-tailed tit or long-tailed bushtit ( Aegithalos caudatus ), occasionally referred to as the silver-throated tit or silver-throated dasher, is a common bird found throughout Europe and Asia. The genus name Aegithalos was a term used by Aristotle for some European tits, including the long-tailed tit. The specific caudatus is Latin and is derived from cauda , "tail".
